highlights.title: U.N. Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel
highlights.summary: In a combative speech, the prime minister defended Israeli military action across the Middle East, and attacked Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York. Dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he took the podium.

highlights.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
highlights.summary: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

highlights.title: At least 41 die as boat capsizes in DRC’s Lake Tanganyika
highlights.summary: Forty-nine passengers have been rescued and a search is under way for the missing.

highlights.title: Nepal não criou crise do clima, mas paga preço colossal por ela, diz premiê
highlights.summary: O primeiro-ministro do Nepal, Balendra Shah, cobrou de líderes políticos escutar alertas sobre a crise climática em seu discurso na Assembleia Geral da ONU nesta quinta-feira (24). highlights.title: Brazil’s Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro still essentially tied in new poll
highlights.summary: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is up two points, but that's still within the poll's margin of error.
